largeheadline.line1: Integrated technologies delivering SmartGuidance™
largeheadline.line2:
Engineered for precision, Spine Guidance 5 Software featuring Copilot is designed to empower you to plan and perform certain spinal procedures with confidence.


Boasting a range of smart features and seamlessly integrating with various VB Spine screw systems, imaging systems, and CORE 2, these innovative technologies are designed to lead you into the future of spine surgery.


To learn more or to request a quote contact us below.

largeheadline.line1:
Spine Guidance 5 Software
Designed to streamline and simplify
largeheadline.line2: Powered by Q, the latest Spine Guidance Software has been designed to help streamline workflows and simplify complex clinical tasks.

largeheadline_copy.line1: Capabilities and benefits
largeheadline_copy.line2:
Our latest Spine Guidance 5 Software includes updates to Smart Segmentation and unveils Copilot, designed to enhance your surgical planning and with the potential to increase the efficiency of your procedural workflow.

 

Designed to help streamline workflows and simplify clinical tasks. Spine Guidance Software’s innovative features include:

text.text:
• Updates to Smart Segmentation
  • Automatic and customizable screw suggestions*
  • Rod visualization and length estimation*
  • Screw Guidance view 
  • Extended tab visualization for MIS screw systems 
  • Auto-detect planned screw 

 *All planned elements require surgeon confirmation.

largeheadline_copy.line1: 4th generation FP8000 camera

text_copy.text:
• The flexibility of multiple optical tracking methods, including full-spectrum active/ passive hybrid optical tracking1

  • Only guidance system/camera with Stryker's proprietary active technology

standaloneimage.alt: preferred image for pg 8 right side

largeheadline_copy.line1:
Automatic screw suggestion:
The power of planning ahead
largeheadline_copy.line2: Algorithm-driven automatic and customizable screw size and trajectory suggestions are confirmed by the surgeon and are designed to:

text_copy.text:
• Help avoid pedicle breaching
  • Help avoid contralateral screw tip interference
  • Enable you to configure size symmetry per level
  • Offer two possible trajectory suggestions for midline and MIS pedicle screw techniques

largeheadline_copy_c.line1: Seamlessly integrated technologies:
largeheadline_copy_c.line2: Spine Guidance 5 Software featuring Copilot is designed to lead you into the future of spine surgery, seamlessly integrating with various VB Spine pedicle screw systems, CORE 2 Console, GE HealthCare OEC 3D C-arm and the Ziehm Imaging Vision RFD 3D C-arm, enabling optimal utilization of your existing technologies.

largeheadline_copy.line1:
Q Pedicle Instruments
Thoughtfully innovated technologies designed to meet your evolving needs.

text_copy.text:
• Up to 12.5% lighter weight than equivalent Navigated Spine Instruments1
  • Q Drills, Q Taps, and Q Screwdrivers are designed to connect directly into the ES6 driver

largeheadline_copy_c.line1:
Introducing Copilot
Adding confidence to your workflow.
largeheadline_copy_c.line2: Enabled by Spine Guidance Software and ActiveTrak technology, Copilot is designed to enhance your surgical planning and has the potential to increase the efficiency of your procedural workflow.

text.text:
Smart Zones
for bone resection

text_1453096837.text:
Collision alerts are designed to give assurance during bone resection, allowing you to hear and feel when you cross the planned boundaries of anatomical no-fly zones with the high speed drill. 

  • Auditory and tactile feedback with the drop of drill RPM 
  • Complete drill stop 
  • Foot pedal - activated drilling 
  • Copilot’s foot pedal provides vibration alerts when crossing planned boundaries, helping keep you in control.

text_copy.text:
Smart screw placement
with automatic depth stop

text_1453096837_copy.text: Copilot Smart Driver2 stops automatically when it reaches the pre-planned depth, supporting your precision during pedicle screw placement.

text_copy.text:
Smart tracking
with 360° ActiveTrack technology

text_1453096837_copy.text: Powered by ActiveTrack technology and enabled by our FP8000 camera, Copilot Q 360° Tracker allows you to follow your plans in near real-time, regardless of your hand position or drill orientation.
